test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC criterion by composing a CTC graph with emissions and computing forward loss scores
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG criterion by composing emissions with transitions and computing forward loss and gradients
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the ASG Viterbi path decoding by composing emissions with transitions and extracting the best path
create_emissions_graph: create a GTN linear graph from a flat emissions vector with optional log-probability conversion
create_ctc_graph: create a CTC graph from a target label sequence and a blank token index
